DESCRIPTION: Enable management access via Boundary

DESCRIPTION: Enable Applications screen and disable QuickID in MCA2

DESCRIPTION: Migrate to single VTEIP per host

DESCRIPTION: listen on proxy tap if exists

DESCRIPTION: listen on asa_int if it exists

DESCRIPTION: space separated list of interfaces to exclude from monitoring (no macros)

DESCRIPTION: Enables the use of the dynip buildsmall target for this hosts vpnpeers

DESCRIPTION: Enable QoS on the WAN backbone

DESCRIPTION: Pull Custom IoCs to sensor

DESCRIPTION: Enable pace2-based firewall PoC

DESCRIPTION: Enable protocol validation in the firewall

DESCRIPTION: Enable threat protection in the firewall

NAME: migrate.2026.logstash2alertd
DESCRIPTION: Logstash to alertd migration group

NAME: fw.dns.log.loki
DESCRIPTION: Enable DNS inspection log shipping to Loki

DESCRIPTION: Defines how external-to-external emails are handled

DESCRIPTION: Enables migration of default internet management traffic to be managed by Path Selection.

DESCRIPTION: Triggers migration to special link types in Path Selection.

DESCRIPTION: Set the leaf qdisc for Bandwidth Control.

DESCRIPTION: Ships fwhits_total via telemetry-mesh (OTel), disables direct remotewrite to Thanos

DESCRIPTION: Enables the Strongswan Sentinel daemon.

NAME: migrate.ipsec.ike_restart_strategy
DESCRIPTION: Triggers migration to IPsec IKE restart strategy.

DESCRIPTION: Use opentelemtery based proxylogd instead of legacy proxylogd

DESCRIPTION: Use new squid certificate validator with CRLite integration.

DESCRIPTION: Controls access to raw nids reports.

NAME: pdfreport.raw.proxy.enabled
DESCRIPTION: Controls access to raw proxy reports.

NAME: pdfreport.raw.mail.enabled
DESCRIPTION: Controls access to raw mail reports.

NAME: wan.api
DESCRIPTION: Enables the CPE WAN API.

NAME: ospfd.redist.connected.gre
DESCRIPTION: Allows redistribution of GRE peer IPs into OSPF.

DESCRIPTION: Allow to ping CPE interfaces from internal networks.

NAME: ndr.ioc.tim
DESCRIPTION: Activate TIM IoCs for block and exclusion lists on the sensor.

NAME: ztna.ep
DESCRIPTION: Enable the enforcement point

NAME: ndr.homenet
DESCRIPTION: Networks considered internal/home networks for NDR (space separated list of IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs)

DESCRIPTION: Additional networks to add on top of ndr.homenet (space separated list of IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs)

NAME: ndr.homenet.exclude
DESCRIPTION: Networks to exclude from ndr.homenet (space separated list of IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs)

NAME: ztna.backup
DESCRIPTION: Enable ZTNA backup

NAME: test.null
DESCRIPTION: For testing random things. Never has any real effects.
